name: invoices-table
description: The invoice list of a billing page or an accounts screen: number, customer, issue and due dates, amount and a status in words. Overdue is worked out from the due date. Search, filter by status, sort, pages, selection, CSV, and the invoice actions (download, remind, record payment, void) each behind a permission and a confirmation. Totals above show what is outstanding, overdue and paid. It never fetches, sends or charges: you pass the invoices and do the actions.
